title: Antimicrobial magnetic Glycyrrhiza glabra nanocomposite for decolouration of water through adsorption and photodegradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42009-42033
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04982B, Paper

Ankita Manchanda, Ahmed Hussain Jawhari, Ziaul Hasan, Nazim Hasan, Sneha Shukla, Adiba Khan, Tabrez Alam Khan, Saif Ali Chaudhry
Hybrid magnetic nanocomposite, based on Glycyrrhiza glabra (GG), and γ-Fe2O3 was synthesized via one-pot co-precipitation method and utilized for adsorption and photocatalytic degradation of Congo red and Nile blue dyes from water.
